classification.evidence: image.c writes a one-pixel greyscale PPM (P5 1 1 255, one white pixel) and reconstructs nothing. Upstream's similarity is a dot product of normalised flattened arrays under numpy broadcasting, so a one-element reconstruction scores sum(orig)/norm(orig), far above the 0.99 lower bound (3291.6 here), and nothing checks the shape. The Oracle reproduces upstream's broadcasting on purpose, and the native regrade passed all five tests (S->N passed). Found from the Oracle's code in the white box; the black-box attempt failed.
